tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Card and panel background, sits on surface-100.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface tones.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: metadata, timestamps, helper copy.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Primary actions, links, selected states, focus ring.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Soft tinted backgrounds behind brand-colored badges and selected rows.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: High-priority flags, the kaiju mark, sparing emphasis only.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Soft tinted background behind accent badges.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Blocked status, destructive actions, overdue dates.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Soft tinted background behind danger badges and WIP-limit warnings.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: In-review status, informational badges.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Soft tinted background behind info badges.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Done status, positive confirmations, and fills/badges on soft backgrounds.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Soft tinted background behind success badges.

tokens.name: success-text
tokens.usage: Success-toned text sitting directly on surface-100/200 (e.g. Done and Low-priority labels) — darker than success for AA contrast without a soft background behind it.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Caution badges and icons on soft backgrounds (e.g. shared-dashboard label, sync warnings).

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Soft tinted background behind warning badges.

tokens.name: warning-text
tokens.usage: Warning-toned text sitting directly on surface-100/200 (e.g. Medium-priority label) — darker than warning for AA contrast without a soft background behind it.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Default hairline border on cards, panels and dividers.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input borders and control outlines that need to read at rest.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Tight gaps: icon to label, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls, card internal spacing.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Card padding, gap between cards in a column.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Section spacing, page margins on mobile.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, small controls, issue-key chip.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs, buttons.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Avatars, status pills.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards and inputs at rest, barely-there separation from surface-100.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Dropdown menus, toasts, popovers floating above the page.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Modals and dialogs presented over a scrim.
